day_shape: 88 items: Houthi-Saudi war dominates with claimed F-15 downing and Aramco Yanbu strike, US officials met Houthis in Oman, IDF Chief Zamir vows to disarm Hezbollah south of Litani, Amnesty publishes 1,000-page report on 2022 Iran crackdown, heavy Khamenei-cycle '200 nights' messaging.

threads.label: Houthi-Saudi war escalates on multiple fronts
threads.summary: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree claimed the downing of a Saudi F-15 over Marib and attacks on Aramco facilities in Yanbu and Khamis Mushait airbase, with Iran International reporting Houthi forces seized a Red Sea coastal stretch. Defa Press claimed satellite imagery shows Yemeni strikes disabled pumping stations on Saudi Arabia's 7 million barrel-per-day East-West pipeline; Houthis denied a drone attack on Mecca.

threads.label: US-Houthi contact and Iran war-powers vote
threads.summary: Reuters, cited by Iran International and Jerusalem Post, reported US officials met Houthi representatives in Oman over the weekend following the Red Sea coast offensive. Seven Republicans joined Democrats backing a resolution directing Trump to withdraw US forces from hostilities against Iran without congressional authorisation.

threads.label: IDF operations against Hezbollah and Palestinian factions
threads.summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt.-Gen. Eyal Zamir told officers on the northern border the military is determined to demilitarise south of the Litani and disarm Hezbollah, urging the Lebanese army to improve. The IDF announced tunnel-dismantling operations under Ali al-Taher Ridge, the elimination of three Hamas/PIJ operatives and Nukhba commander Jihad Samih Mahmoud Ismail, and the arrest of senior PIJ figure Mohammed Saadi near Jenin.

threads.label: Iran sanctions and overseas plots
threads.summary: US Treasury convened global financial institutions to advance Iran sanctions; Sweden summoned Iran's ambassador and expelled an embassy official. Petah Tikva resident Alexander Granovsky received 13.5 years for work for an Iranian agent, four were convicted over a plot to kill an Israeli nuclear scientist, and CNN reported Russian spy satellites may have aided Iranian strikes on US bases during Operation Epic Fury.

threads.label: Khamenei-cycle '200 nights' messaging
threads.summary: Khamenei's office, IRIB and Defa Press ran a heavy coordinated cycle marking the '200th night' of street presence, with messages from President Pezeshkian, Armed Forces chief Alireza Abdollahi, Police chief Radan and NSC Secretary Mohsen Rezaei praising public steadfastness. IRIB also reported a claimed 5,000-strong Jaan-Fada battalion exercise in Rey.

threads.label: Iran claims on US F-15 and diplomacy
threads.summary: IRGC spokesman Mohabi told IRIB and Defa Press that US accounts of rescuing a pilot were 'Hollywood-style' and claimed wreckage of a downed American F-15 was hauled off by excavator; Speaker Qalibaf tied US inflation expectations to the Strait of Hormuz. Foreign Minister Araghchi described Iran-China ties as strategically guided; NSC Secretary Rezaei told KDP's Bafel Talabani Iran has 'no trust whatsoever' in America.

threads.label: Mahsa Amini anniversary coverage
threads.summary: On the fourth anniversary of Mahsa Amini's death, Amnesty International published a 1,000-page investigation alleging systematic state-organised murder, torture and sexual violence to crush the 2022 Woman, Life, Freedom uprising. Iran International and Jerusalem Post ran survivor testimonies and reported one January-protest victim faces a 26th surgery.

Coordinated pressure by major American stadium owners and removal of Macklemore from Ed Sheeran's world tour due to chanting 'Free Palestine', lifted the curtain on the deep influence of Zionist lobbies over the entertainment industry. Macklemore, a well-known rapper and Grammy award winner, due to explicit support for the Palestinian people and performance of protest music, faced coordinated pressure from major American stadium owners and was sidelined from accompanying Ed Sheeran's concert tour. This decision was made after tour organisers had exhausted persuasion of venue operators based on completely cancelling concerts if this performer was present...
